Maya K.: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth is blocked on the Dedicated migration tasks and their onboarding pace is slipping. Renewal health flagged as medium-risk if we don't accelerate enablement this week. Can we open extra APAC-friendly slots?
Diego R.: Yep, saw the note in Gainsight. I can do Tue 09:00 SGT / Mon 17:00 PDT window. Would that help? :thinking_face:
Anika S.: We should avoid a single long island-style session. My suggestion: run a 45m advanced lab for their infra lead + a 30m drop-in for devs. Trainers: Samira for infra, Evan for prompts.
Samira T.: I can cover infra but I already have a Dedicated deep-dive on Thu 10:30 SGT. If we move that deep-dive to Fri morning I can take Tue 09:00 SGT for Nova.
Evan L.: I can do the dev drop-in Tue 09:45 SGT. I'll prepare a short prompt/templating checklist and a sample `docker-compose` snippet for local testing.
Diego R.: OK — if we're swapping Thu->Fri for the deep-dive we should check with Meridian. I'll ping them separately. For now propose this booking: Tue 09:00-09:45 SGT (infra), Tue 09:45-10:15 SGT (dev drop-in).
Maya K.: To reduce churn, we also need a quick 1-pager recap + action items sent right after. Add recording + transcription requirement. Capture ability to run a Dedicated smoke test during the session.
Diego R.: Scheduling note + calendar link: https://cal.redwood.team/book?slot=nova-1729 — tentative until Samira confirms swap. agenda snippet below — please react :thumbsup: if this works
Diego R.: ```
09:00-09:05 - intro & goals
09:05-09:25 - infra checklist + network/KMS validation (Samira)
09:25-09:35 - Dedicated smoke run (live)
09:35-09:45 - breakout Qs + next steps
09:45-10:15 - dev drop-in: prompt patterns + CI tips (Evan)
```
Anika S.: Can we also add a short feedback capture form at the end? One-liner + severity (blocker/annoyance/ok). I'll add to the follow-up recap.
Evan L.: I'll drop the prompt set in the CS playbooks repo: `docs/cs-playbooks/novahealth/prompts.md` and share before EOD.
Samira T.: Confirmed — I can swap the deep-dive to Fri 08:30 SGT. Booking ok from my side.
calendar-bot: Booking created (provisional): Tue 2024-05-14 09:00 SGT — Organizer: Diego R. — Guests: Maya K., Samira T., Evan L., NovaHealth Engineers — link: https://cal.redwood.team/event/9876
Maya K.: Awesome, thank you. Action list: (1) Diego finalize invites + record flag, (2) Evan upload prompts, (3) Anika prep feedback form + 1-pager recap template, (4) Samira confirm Fri deep-dive swap with Meridian. Please confirm in thread by EOD so I can update the renewal tracker. :eyes:
Diego R.: Confirmed, will send invites and set recording on.
Evan L.: Confirmed, prompts file will be up by 17:00 PDT.
Anika S.: Confirmed, I'll draft the feedback form and recap.
Samira T.: Confirmed.
Maya K.: Great — will mark the renewal play as 'engaged' for this week. If anything changes ping here.
